notes.title: Oldage is no longer available
notes.content:
[list]
[*] "Why can't i play anymore?"
You can't play anymore because the servers have been shutdown, the game no longer generates revenue which means the servers were consuming money without generating any - for that reason they had to be turn off.
[*] "Is it ever going to come back?"
Probably not, the game is not going to change if it ever comes back and if this time it failed, why would it be any different in the future?
[*] "What about an offline mode?"
Oldage is never getting an offline mode, but if you wanna check out other games that are inspired by it, you can do so by visiting this link: https://discord.gg/mtTytfu
[/list]
So this is it, thank you to everyone who gave this game a try and became part of the community, i appreciate it!
Cheers

notes.title: Oldage Patch 3.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30771188/ebefdcc28b6af11622bebe211bcf1ae78721e1f4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Removed the old tutorial
- It was bad, i'm sorry
[*] Completely remade the Market from ground up
- This includes a new tutorial that is supposed to let the player understand better how the game works
- The new market also allows you to test and control units like you own them
- And it's very pretty too ːkinghappyː
[*] Added a flex queue that will allow you to queue at anytime
- You can cap your units amount to only five if you want
- Rapidfire matches only happen if both parties agree
- Ranked queue is still the same
[*] Added a new unit called Bowman
- Similar to the marksman, he shoots arrows instead
[*] Added five new achievements
- A few achievements from the new map mechanic
- Another achievement from the spectator mode
[*] Added a new mechanic that makes the map cubes fall down until a single cube is left
- This is supposed to make the matches faster
- Also really fun
[*] Made an overhaul on the interface and optimization
- Fixed some issues, made others lighter
[/list]
This is it guys! Next update we should bring in new units, and maybe, who knows, something about a campaign mode?
Cheers!

Most of you who already played Oldage saw that there was [b]something[/b] off with the inputs

You can now do actions faster, without having to wait for all animations in the field to play out
And it's (hopefully) bug free.
We already fixed a couple of other bugs into the game, so here are the patch notes:

[list]

[*] Fixed a bug in which the client, on a big delay, would not load up properly and display weird UI glitches as well as units with no name in the center of the screen

[*] Fixed a bug that when pushing dead units, they would lose their move exhaust

[*] Fixed the input lag "bug"

[/list]

Thank you all for the feedback you've given, and i hope to see you in the battlefields!

Cheers!

* Connection with the game is now generally faster due to a new server!

* You can now add friends by clicking on a message and selecting a button

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0 (13/10/2017)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30771188/b38edd69f155e2aa15928fa86dca92cbf8acd065.png[/img]
- Fixed the Gold Boost not working issue
- Fixed the Empty Room that you can't leave issue
- Fixed the Matchmaking issue (capped at 4 units difference)
- You can no longer sell units if you have less than 3 units
- Added a match ID in chat so you can report if something went wrong

- Refunded everyone that lost gold from the last server crash
People who got their gold refunded:
*Crorix
*Robbulo94
*HumanMetal
*Daffyboy123

- Added a new functionality to set server maintenance
- Fixed the Priest's description in the market

Since the server has been abruptly taken down, you can still file a report to tell us if something bad happened

Thank you all for playing and have fun in Oldage!
